justification: Bundled identity has no configured certificate-revocation cache. Even UDS identity-config defaults CRL checking off; OCSP alone does not establish the local-cache behavior this specific rule requires.
next_step: Configure supported local CRL/cache refresh for disconnected operation or an accepted equivalent at the actual certificate-authentication boundary.
owner: Gallatin SRE; MPN/UDS operator for inherited controls
investigation: Explicit official-rule decision from pinned Core/Horizon source and configuration. No live MPN test claimed.

title: AAA Services must be configured to include only approved trust anchors in trust stores or certificate stores managed by the organization.
components: Selected Keycloak/Authservice path; bundled Keycloak is current candidate default
justification: Core accepts supplied gateway/IdP trust material, but the actual approved DoD/partner CA roots and certificate chains are deployment inputs. A generic trust bundle mechanism cannot identify which roots MPN supplied.
next_step: Record approved roots, full certificate chains and the selected certificate consumer; map SPIFFE transport versus DoD user authentication explicitly.
